items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair including thermal-imaging leak detection
items.rationale: Repair of internal frost burst fitting and leak detection is covered under escape of water and fracture damage to pipework inside buildings; thermal imaging leak detection is covered as leak location.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint)
items.rationale: Exterior plaster frost damage is excluded unless frost action on external surfaces peril is agreed; here it is not agreed, so no cover despite damage being related.
